canonical_name: Spango Valley data centre and BESS (former IBM site, Greenock)

aliases.alias: Former IBM site, Inverkip Road, Greenock

summary: Live proposal for four data-centre buildings totalling about 80,000 sqm at the cleared former IBM Spango Valley factory site, south-west Greenock. Planning permission in principle application 26/0136/IC was received by Inverclyde Council on 22 July 2026, validated on 26 August and remains pending. The developer's earlier consultation material described a maximum 150 MW data centre and a separately proposed battery system of about 99 MW, but the 150 MW figure is not stated in the main application summary. A consented housing-led mixed-use scheme for up to 450 homes also exists for the site; how the two proposals legally relate remains unresolved. The developer states it has a Gate 1 grid offer and interest from an unnamed operator; no operator, IT-load split or cooling and water demand has been confirmed.
maturity_explanation: Formal planning permission in principle application 26/0136/IC was received on 22 July and validated by Inverclyde Council on 26 August 2026. It was pending consideration when checked on 3 September 2026. The separate BESS Section 36 proposal has not yet been located as a formal Energy Consents Unit case.
anticipated_operational_date: not stated; planning permission targeted end-2026 (developer, via press)

latest_development.headline: Planning permission in principle application 26/0136/IC validated; pending consideration with public comments invited to 16 September 2026
